rationale: tv_iterative-claude-agentic: val_n=200, tv_lambda=0.00275, tv_iterations=1000, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-15 LAMBDA peak bracket (high side). Peak at lambda=2.5e-3 (iter-8 hr=0.36286 best); neighbors 2.25e-3->0.36073 (iter-14) and 3e-3->0.3597 (iter-7) both lower. ONE knob: tv_lambda 2.5e-3->2.75e-3 to bracket the high side (best config otherwise gd, 1000it, lr=0.01, decay=0.01, fbp). HYPOTHESIS: if hr>0.36286 the true optimum is just above 2.5e-3 (between 2.5 and 3e-3); if hr<0.36286, lambda=2.5e-3 is the confirmed plain-TV optimum on breast. Budget: ~950s at 1000 iters, <1200s wall.
